versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No new features, fixes, or documentation updates were made.

- Initial release of the World Bank Indicators API skill.
- Fetch country-level economic and development indicators (GDP, population, unemployment, etc.) via public World Bank API—no API key required.
- Includes a Python script for fast common queries and indicator/code discovery.
- Provides guidance on constructing queries, using country and aggregate codes, interpreting results, and handling errors.
- Reference tables list the most-used indicators; further discovery supported via included documentation and scripts.
